notes: Profile comment completion checks the actor that initiated the request before applying a persisted response or rollback, so navigation to another profile is preserved.
Successful reconciliation updates only the comment list on the current post and preserves concurrent like state and other post fields; failure removes only its own optimistic comment.
Hermetic common tests cover success and failure after navigation plus a late successful comment response after a concurrent like.

This focal reduction does not rerun or replace the existing Web, Android and iOS profile-content evidence. It does not certify backend concurrency, authorization denial, retry UI or unrelated profile races.
